# opstracer_schedule (Data Source)

Look up an on-call schedule by its exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opstracer_schedule" "backend" {
  name = "backend-oncall"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Schedule name, matched exactly.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Schedule ID.
- `time_zone` (String) IANA time zone of the schedule.
